news.title: Colom says he’s ‘excited’ to work with Trump at Itawamba County town hall
news.summary: Sen.-elect Scott Colom (D-Miss.) on Sunday said during a town hall event in Fulton, Miss., his first since defeating incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith (R-Miss.) that he’s “excited” to work with President Trump on several issues, including healthcare. Colom hosted the event, streamed on the Tupelo, Miss.-based outlet WTVA, to speak with constituents and community leaders…
